entries.name: Covenant College
entries.affiliation: Presbyterian Church in America (official college of the PCA)
entries.doctrinal_basis: Faculty annually subscribe to the inerrancy of Scripture, the Westminster Standards and the college's Statement of Community Beliefs (byFaith). Its board of trustees is elected by the PCA General Assembly.
points_to_weigh: Official college of the PCA, with denominational oversight of its board.

A recent core-curriculum update drew criticism from some conservative Reformed commentators, who questioned the direction of the college and how its faculty engage secular scholarship (Aquila Report).
In 2023 the confessional Reformed writer R. Scott Clark recommended Covenant College to parents, citing its student-handbook policy on sex and gender (Heidelblog).
Assessments differ; families wanting the stricter end of PCA and OPC practice should read the Community Statement of Beliefs and faculty statements directly.
entries.description: Liberal arts college of the Presbyterian Church in America.

entries.name: Reformation Bible College
entries.doctrinal_basis: All faculty are committed to the Westminster Confession of Faith; students are expected to attend a church that affirms the Westminster Standards, the Three Forms of Unity or the 1689 Baptist Confession (RBC).
points_to_weigh: Not yet accredited: holds applicant status with the Association for Biblical Higher Education, a pre-membership status (ABHE).
Leadership transition: President Stephen Nichols concluded his tenure on May 31, 2026 (RBC).
entries.description: Reformed Bible college founded by R. C. Sproul, operated by Ligonier Ministries.

entries.name: Calvin University
entries.affiliation: Christian Reformed Church in North America
entries.doctrinal_basis: Faculty and trustees sign the Covenant for Faculty Members, affirming the Belgic Confession, Heidelberg Catechism and Canons of Dort (Calvin Chimes).
points_to_weigh: A number of faculty have filed gravamina (formal disagreements) over the CRC's confessional position on sexuality; in 2024 the CRC's Synod told Calvin's board to align its processes with the denomination's (Religion News Service; Calvin Chimes).
In 2009 the board restricted faculty advocacy on homosexuality, and the faculty senate voted to ask for its withdrawal (Wikipedia).
In 2023 R. Scott Clark warned parents about Calvin, citing sanctioned LGBTQ student groups (Heidelblog).
Calvin's current policy states that sexual relations belong in marriage between a man and a woman (Wikipedia).
entries.description: Large university of the Christian Reformed Church.

entries.name: New Saint Andrews College
entries.affiliation: Christ Church, Moscow and the Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches (CREC)
entries.doctrinal_basis: Classical Christian liberal arts college affiliated with Christ Church and the CREC (Wikipedia).
points_to_weigh: Founded by Douglas Wilson, a leading proponent of the Federal Vision, and affiliated with the CREC, which includes Federal Vision adherents (Wikipedia: CREC).
Federal Vision teaching was formally criticized by the OPC (2006 report), the PCA (2007 study committee), the URCNA (2010) and other Reformed bodies (Wikipedia: Federal Vision).
A denomination outside the PCA and OPC; the CREC practices paedocommunion (Wikipedia).

entries.name: Bob Jones University
entries.doctrinal_basis: The BJU Creed affirms biblical inspiration, creation of man by the direct act of God, the virgin birth, the vicarious atonement, the bodily resurrection and the new birth by the Holy Spirit; the university also publishes position statements on specific issues (BJU).
points_to_weigh: Not Reformed: it identifies with historic Fundamentalism, including separation from perceived apostasy.
Accredited by both the regional accreditor SACSCOC and by TRACS (BJU).
A 2014 independent GRACE report on BJU's handling of abuse reports found the university had discouraged reporting; the president apologized (Wikipedia).

2018–2020: WSCUC placed the university on probation over governance concerns; the sanction was lifted in November 2020 (Wikipedia).
